SELECT a.id, a.title, a.club_id, c.name AS club_name, a.location, a.category, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.signup_deadline, a.capacity, a.joined_count, a.status, a.cover_color FROM activity a INNER JOIN club c ON c.id = a.club_id WHERE a.status = 1
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR a.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND a.category = #{q.category}
AND a.signup_deadline > NOW() AND a.joined_count < a.capacity
AND a.signup_deadline <= NOW() AND a.start_time > NOW()
AND a.joined_count >= a.capacity AND a.end_time >= NOW()
AND a.end_time < NOW()
ORDER BY a.start_time ASC, a.id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.club_id, c.name AS club_name, a.location, a.category, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.signup_deadline, a.capacity, a.joined_count, a.status, a.cover_color, a.description, a.rules, a.created_by, u.nickname AS creator_name, a.created_at FROM activity a INNER JOIN club c ON c.id = a.club_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.created_by WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.status = 1
